Title: Click "Simple Alert" and check the alert text is "I am an alert box!".
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Click Simple Alert. 2. Read the alert text. 3. Accept the alert.
Expected Result: The alert text is "I am an alert box!".

Title: Click "Confirmation Alert", press OK and check the page shows "You pressed OK!".
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Click Confirmation Alert. 2. Accept the alert. 3. Read the result text.

Title: Click "Confirmation Alert", press Cancel and check the page shows "You pressed Cancel!".
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Click Confirmation Alert. 2. Dismiss the alert. 3. Read the result text.

Title: Click "Prompt Alert" and check the prompt asks "Please enter your name:".
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Click Prompt Alert. 2. Read the prompt text. 3. Dismiss the prompt.
Expected Result: The prompt text is "Please enter your name:".

Title: Enter the name "Allah" in the prompt, press OK and check the greeting "Hello Allah! How are you today?".
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Click Prompt Alert. 2. Type the name in the prompt. 3. Accept the prompt. 4. Read the result text.
Expected Result: The result is "Hello Allah! How are you today?".

Title: Click "Prompt Alert", press Cancel and check the page shows "User cancelled the prompt.".
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Click Prompt Alert. 2. Dismiss the prompt. 3. Read the result text.
Expected Result: The result is "User cancelled the prompt.".

Title: Click "New Tab" and check a second tab opens with pavantestingtools.com.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Click the New Tab button. 2. Wait for a second window. 3. Switch to the window with pavantestingtools.com. 4. Close the new window. 5. Read the heading of the first window.
Expected Result: A new tab with pavantestingtools.com opens. After closing it, the practice page heading is still shown.

Title: Click "Popup Windows" and check two windows open (selenium.dev and playwright.dev).
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Click the Popup Windows button. 2. Wait for 3 windows in total. 3. Switch to the selenium.dev window. 4. Switch to the playwright.dev window. 5. Close the extra windows.
Expected Result: Two popup windows open (selenium.dev and playwright.dev); after closing them one window is left.

Title: Search Wikipedia for "Selenium" and check "Selenium" and "Selenium (software)" are listed.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Type the search text in the Wikipedia box. 2. Click Search. 3. Read the result list.

Title: Search Wikipedia for "Selenium" and check the result links open in a new tab.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Search for Selenium. 2. Read the target attribute of a result link.

Title: Open the result "Selenium (software)" and check the Wikipedia page opens in a new tab.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Search for Selenium. 2. Click the result "Selenium (software)". 3. Switch to the new window. 4. Read the page title. 5. Close the new window.
Expected Result: A new tab with wikipedia.org/wiki/Selenium_(software) opens and its title contains "Selenium".

Title: Search for "Python", click "More" and check the full Wikipedia search opens in a new tab.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Search for Python. 2. Click the More link. 3. Switch to the new window. 4. Read the URL. 5. Close the new window.
Expected Result: A new tab with the Wikipedia search "search=Python" opens.
